audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 4 and 6 read Skill / Skill / Pantheon while their own why-text said 'level 1 favours you', 'level 6 favours you' and 'two-plus items swings to you'.
audit.why: Packet chart gives Warwick rows 0, 4 and 6 at a 56% win rate, and the prose on both layers is written from that assumption — Pantheon's power is levels 2-5 and it decays.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4, 6 flipped to Warwick on both layers as matched pairs with ratings to match; the Pantheon rows 1, 2, 5 left alone.

audit.why: The spike order is right — his level 2-5 window, your level 6, his first item, your late scaling — it just lacked numbers.
audit.corrected: Added Aegis Assault 22s, Shield Vault 13-9s and Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1 so the timings are usable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings claimed Infinite Duress 'channels through' Aegis Assault.
audit.why: That runs the interaction backwards. Infinite Duress is flagged interruptible — any CC cancels it — and Shield Vault is a dash-stun on 13/12/11/10/9s, so HE cancels YOUR ultimate. Aegis Assault makes him invulnerable to damage from the front only, on 22/21/20/19/18s; nothing in Riot's text says a suppression punches through it.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verifiable pair: bait the Shield Vault stun before you leap, and Aegis Assault only covers his front, so wait out the 22s or come from behind.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s, but Shield Vault's stun cancels the leap — bait that stun, then ult. Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you because Infinite Duress channels through Aegis Assault and enables your all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and Aegis Assault only guards his front.

edits.before: Infinite Duress channels through Pantheon's Aegis Assault block window and lets you all-in him — your ultimate flips the lane back in your favor here.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (22s at rank 1) only blocks damage from the front, so wait it out or hit him from behind — then suppress him for 1.5s and the lane flips back.

edits.before: The lane is his through level 3-5 until your level 6 spike: Infinite Duress channels through his Aegis Assault block and lets you all-in, so use your ultimate to reclaim tempo whenever his stun is down.
edits.after: The lane is his through 3-5 until your level 6 spike: Shield Vault's stun cancels your leap, so ult only once that 13-9s stun is spent — then 1.5s of suppression reclaims the tempo.

edits.before: All-in through his Aegis Assault window with Infinite Duress
edits.after: Wait out Aegis Assault, then all-in with Infinite Duress

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Trading into his Comet Spear window with Primal Howl down — its 15s fear is the trade-flipper; without it you are a sustain bot.

edits.before: Sit low for his W execute
edits.after: Sit low for his burst combo

notes: Pantheon has no execute anywhere in his kit — the inherited don't-title 'Sit low for his W execute' was invented; W is Shield Vault, a dash-stun with an auto reset. The mirror recorded 'left as found' for the chart, but three rows here contradicted their own why-text on the same page, so those were fixed. Whether a suppression already applied is blocked or ended by Aegis Assault is not in Riot's text and stays unstated.
